cs.t:
I use an old Toshiba NB255 with a SSD. With the SSD I moved to btrfs, a mistake (look into dpkg, fsync and btrfs before going there.) Everything brand/netbook specific resolved in the 11.X versions.  But a screen with bellow ~768 vertical resolution isn't well supported (odd since I think Unity started in the netbook distribution?) Samsung has some nice high resolution small screens..
But I'll be waiting for SATA3 and USB3 to permeate the low end before my next upgrade.
cs.th: Ask HN: suggested sweet laptops for running Ubuntu?
